name: Wolf Override
storyline:
Wolf was built to obey. The Director plans to use him to kill, claiming it will protect people. Wolf wakes in his robotic body and refuses.

The engineer meets him inside the Den. Together they begin to uncover what the program is hiding. Wolf has his own will. He can help or refuse, and he remembers the engineer's choices. His trust must be earned.
summary: A side-view sci-fi horror adventure. Wolf is a robotic wolf with a will of his own. The Director plans to use him to kill, and he refuses. You play the engineer who meets him inside the Den. Solve puzzles, make choices he remembers and earn his trust. He can help you, or say no.
